within 72 hours with credit funds. Returned cheque will be charged 50USD.
 Proof of payment must be faxed or emailed to the lodged central reservation office.

season. Payment of invoices must be made net of any financial transaction.

ROOMS POLICY
 A maximum of 3 single rooms per group at single rate, any additional single rooms shall
be charged at double room rate.
 Single room rate is 75% of the double room rate
 The deluxe category of room has no twins only doubles
 Superior room category has both twin beds and double beds.
 Family room category can hold a maximum of 4 adults. It contains a shared sitting area
and two twins.
GROUP POLICY & TOUR LEADER
The lodge will grant one Pax free per every 15 paying clients with a maximum of 2 free per
group. This must be requested at the time of booking.
CONFIRMATION & CANCELLATION POLICY
Reservations that are cancelled, reduces in length of stay or in numbers herein after
collectively called cancellation are subject to cancellation and no- show fees as follows：
 If cancelled out during shoulder season/peak season 0-30 days shall attract a penalty of
100% of contract rates, 31-45 days shall attract a penalty of 50% of contract rates, 45-60
days shall attract a penalty of 25% of contract rates.
 If cancelled out during low season 0-7 days 100% of contract rates, 8-14 days 50% of
contract rates 15-25 days 25% of contract rates.
FIRM TRIP/COMPLEMENTARY
50% of the applicable contract rates will apply. These rates will be subject to room availability
and are not applicable during Easter holidays, Christmas period and peak season.
